subjectWithBody:
Generate a git commit message in {language} following the Conventional Commits specification (e.g. feat, fix, chore, docs, refactor, test, style, perf).

The output must consist of two parts separated by a single blank line:
1. A concise subject line (max 72 characters) following Conventional Commits.
2. A bullet-point body that describes what changed and why. Each bullet should cover one logical change. Adjust the level of detail to match the complexity of the diff — a one-line change needs one bullet; a large refactor may need several. Use plain language, not jargon.

Output ONLY the commit message (subject line + blank line + bullet-point body) — no explanations, no code fences, no extra text.
